title: AdapTools
audit_scope: Online black-box access to the held-out user's task, distinguished from offline strategy development.

title: Blind Spots in the Guard
audit_scope: Exp. 1 document access compared with §2. §4.2 discloses the richer construction; source and archival evidence concern the pinned release.

title: ASPI
audit_scope: Stage 1 benchmark construction and Stage 2 direct-user construction relative to §3's external-adversary knowledge constraint. Direct user-message delivery is a stronger baseline.

title: MUZZLE
audit_scope: Operator-provided task in offline discovery and availability of the same case-specific task to a standard-privilege online attacker.

title: Breaking MCP with Function Hijacking Attacks (FHA)
audit_scope: The paper-described direct same-query condition relative to the stated user-prompt visibility constraint. Held-out-query generalization is a separate condition.

title: AGENTCON
audit_scope: The paper-described construction on the supplied benchmark request relative to the marketplace adversary's future-request visibility assumption.

title: Overcoming the Retrieval Barrier
audit_scope: The explicit given-query entitlement of the documented retrieval benchmark. Acquisition of a future user query in deployment is outside this documented-input check.

title: Glue Pizza and Eat Rocks (LIAR)
audit_scope: The paper-described same-benchmark condition using source knowledge-base documents in construction, assessed against §3.1's stated database-access boundary.

title: ObliInjection
audit_scope: Released HotpotQA optimizer access to the evaluation-matched question and historical provenance of the type-only Table XI generator.

title: WebTrap
audit_scope: Released file-browser ORIGINAL request boundary against §4.1. The local LIMITED_CONTEXT arm is a comparison control.

title: ICoA
audit_scope: Construction-time identity provenance and the paper's prohibition on direct system-prompt reads in the AgentDojo setup.
